738:     fn compile_parse_regex(&self) -> Result<FancyRegex, ShellError> {
739:         let item_to_parse = if self.parse_regex_mode {
740:             self.parse_pattern.clone()
741:         } else {
742:             self.build_simple_parse_pattern()?
743:         };
744:         FancyRegex::new(&item_to_parse).map_err(|e| ShellError::GenericError {
745:             error: "Error with regular expression".into(),
746:             msg: e.to_string(),
747:             span: Some(self.parse_pattern_span),
748:             help: None,
749:             inner: vec![],
750:         })
751:     }

753:     fn build_simple_parse_pattern(&self) -> Result<String, ShellError> {
754:         let mut output = "(?s)\\A".to_string();
755:         let mut loop_input = self.parse_pattern.chars().peekable();
756:         loop {
757:             let mut before = String::new();
758:             while let Some(c) = loop_input.next() {
759:                 if c == '{' {
760:                     if loop_input.peek() == Some(&'{') {
761:                         let _ = loop_input.next();
762:                     } else {
763:                         break;
764:                     }
765:                 }
766:                 before.push(c);
767:             }
768: 
769:             if !before.is_empty() {
770:                 output.push_str(&fancy_regex::escape(&before));
771:             }
772: 
773:             let mut column = String::new();
774:             while let Some(c) = loop_input.next() {
775:                 if c == '}' {
776:                     break;
777:                 }
778:                 column.push(c);
779:                 if loop_input.peek().is_none() {
780:                     return Err(ShellError::DelimiterError {
781:                         msg: "Found opening `{` without an associated closing `}`".to_owned(),
782:                         span: self.parse_pattern_span,
783:                     });
784:                 }
785:             }
786: 
787:             if !column.is_empty() {
788:                 output.push_str("(?P<");
789:                 output.push_str(&column);
790:                 output.push_str(">.*?)");
791:             }
792: 
793:             if before.is_empty() && column.is_empty() {
794:                 break;
795:             }
796:         }
797: 
798:         output.push_str("\\z");
799:         Ok(output)
800:     }

814:     fn parse_pipeline(
815:         &self,
816:         engine_state: &EngineState,
817:         input: PipelineData,
818:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
819:         let worker = SubCommand {
820:             parse_pattern: self.parse_pattern.clone(),
821:             parse_pattern_span: self.parse_pattern_span,
822:             parse_regex_mode: self.parse_regex_mode,
823:             parse_head: self.parse_head,
824:             ..SubCommand::default()
825:         };
826:         let regex = worker.compile_parse_regex()?;
827:         let columns = worker.parse_capture_columns(&regex);
828:         let head = worker.parse_head;
829:         match input {
830:             PipelineData::Empty => Ok(PipelineData::Empty),
831:             PipelineData::Value(value, ..) => match value {
832:                 Value::String { val, .. } => {
833:                     let captures = regex
834:                         .captures_iter(&val)
835:                         .map(|captures| worker.parse_capture_record(captures, &columns))
836:                         .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
837:                     Ok(Value::list(captures, head).into_pipeline_data())
838:                 }
839:                 Value::List { vals, .. } => {
840:                     let iter = vals.into_iter().map(move |val| {
841:                         let span = val.span();
842:                         val.into_string().map_err(|_| ShellError::PipelineMismatch {
843:                             exp_input_type: "string".into(),
844:                             dst_span: head,
845:                             src_span: span,
846:                         })
847:                     });
848:                     let iter = ParseIter {
849:                         captures: VecDeque::new(),
850:                         regex,
851:                         columns,
852:                         iter,
853:                         span: head,
854:                         signals: engine_state.signals().clone(),
855:                     };
856:                     Ok(ListStream::new(iter, head, Signals::empty()).into())
857:                 }
858:                 value => Err(worker.parse_type_error(value.span())),
859:             },
860:             PipelineData::ListStream(stream, ..) => Ok(stream
861:                 .modify(|stream| {
862:                     let iter = stream.map(move |val| {
863:                         let span = val.span();
864:                         val.into_string().map_err(|_| ShellError::PipelineMismatch {
865:                             exp_input_type: "string".into(),
866:                             dst_span: head,
867:                             src_span: span,
868:                         })
869:                     });
870:                     ParseIter {
871:                         captures: VecDeque::new(),
872:                         regex,
873:                         columns,
874:                         iter,
875:                         span: head,
876:                         signals: engine_state.signals().clone(),
877:                     }
878:                 })
879:                 .into()),
880:             PipelineData::ByteStream(stream, ..) => {
881:                 if let Some(lines) = stream.lines() {
882:                     let iter = ParseIter {
883:                         captures: VecDeque::new(),
884:                         regex,
885:                         columns,
886:                         iter: lines,
887:                         span: head,
888:                         signals: engine_state.signals().clone(),
889:                     };
890:                     Ok(ListStream::new(iter, head, Signals::empty()).into())
891:                 } else {
892:                     Ok(PipelineData::Empty)
893:                 }
894:             }
895:         }
896:     }

899:         ShellError::PipelineMismatch {
900:             exp_input_type: "string".into(),
901:             dst_span: self.parse_head,
902:             src_span,
903:         }
904:     }

906:     fn parse_capture_record(
907:         &self,
908:         captures: Result<Captures, fancy_regex::Error>,
909:         columns: &[String],
910:     ) -> Result<Value, ShellError> {
911:         let captures = captures.map_err(|err| ShellError::GenericError {
912:             error: "Error with regular expression captures".into(),
913:             msg: err.to_string(),
914:             span: Some(self.parse_head),
915:             help: None,
916:             inner: vec![],
917:         })?;
918:         let record = columns
919:             .iter()
920:             .zip(captures.iter().skip(1))
921:             .map(|(column, match_)| {
922:                 let match_str = match_.map(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
923:                 (column.clone(), Value::string(match_str, self.parse_head))
924:             })
925:             .collect();
926:         Ok(Value::record(record, self.parse_head))
927:     }

1118:                         record.push(&header.item, pre_o.1.clone());

1126:     fn detect_fill_missing(
1127:         &self,
1128:         headers: &[Spanned<String>],
1129:         row: &[Spanned<String>],
1130:         name_span: Span,
1131:     ) -> Vec<(String, Value)> {
1132:         let span = if name_span == Span::unknown() {
1133:             self.table_head
1134:         } else {
1135:             name_span
1136:         };
1137:         let mut pre_output = vec![];
1138:         for cell in row {
1139:             for header in headers {
1140:                 if cell.span.start <= header.span.end && cell.span.end > header.span.start {
1141:                     pre_output.push((header.item.to_string(), Value::string(&cell.item, span)));
1142:                 }
1143:             }
1144:         }
1145:         for header in headers {
1146:             let mut found = false;
1147:             for pre_o in &pre_output {
1148:                 if pre_o.0 == header.item {
1149:                     found = true;
1150:                     break;
1151:                 }
1152:             }
1153:             if !found {
1154:                 pre_output.push((header.item.to_string(), Value::nothing(span)));
1155:             }
1156:         }
1157:         pre_output
1158:     }

1160:     fn merge_detect_record(&self, record: Record, input_span: Span) -> Value {
1161:         match &self.detect_combine {
1162:             Some(range) => {
1163:                 let (start_index, end_index) = match self.process_detect_range(range, record.len(), input_span)
1164:                 {
1165:                     Ok(Some((l_idx, r_idx))) => (l_idx, r_idx),
1166:                     Ok(None) => return Value::record(record, input_span),
1167:                     Err(e) => return Value::error(e, input_span),
1168:                 };
